*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font-family:-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.6}

pre{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--ln);border-radius:8px;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;font-size:.88rem;color:#c9d1d9}
.pl{display:inline-block;padding:3px 11px;margin:3px;border:1px solid;border-radius:99px;font-size:.78rem;font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;background:#0a0910}
.pg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:14px}

table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.92rem}td,th{border:1px solid var(--ln);padding:8px 12px;text-align:left}tr:nth-child(even){background:var(--card)}
.st{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:6px}
.sc{background:#0a0910;border:1px solid #2a2330;border-radius:10px;padding:18px;min-height:150px}.sc b{color:var(--ac);display:block;margin-bottom:10px}.sc i{display:block;height:8px;border-radius:9px;margin:9px 0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff5a1f,#ffa36c);opacity:.8}
.bt{display:inline-block;padding:8px 18px;margin:4px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--ac);color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem}.bt.d{background:#0a0910;border:1px solid var(--ln)}
.ft{height:90px;margin:26px -40px -40px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0d1117,#ff5a1f);clip-path:ellipse(75% 100% at 50% 100%)}
.ft{margin-left:calc(-1*clamp(16px,4vw,40px));margin-right:calc(-1*clamp(16px,4vw,40px));margin-bottom:calc(-1*clamp(16px,4vw,40px))}
